faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions? We have answers
faq.q1: How long does it take to set up?
faq.a1: Setting up takes just minutes. Connect your cloud accounts through our secure API integrations, and you'll start seeing insights right away.
faq.q2: Do you support all cloud providers?
faq.a2: We support AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, and more. Our platform is constantly expanding to include additional providers.
faq.q3: How much can I expect to save?
faq.a3: On average, our customers save 23-37% on their cloud bills. Your results may vary based on your current cloud setup and optimization level.
faq.a4: Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption and security practices. We never store your cloud credentials and only access the billing data needed for analysis.
